name: CuFe Ltd
summary: CuFe Ltd. explores for and advances mineral resources spanning lithium, copper, iron, gold and base metals. It has interests in many Western Australian projects, among them JWD, Yarram, Tennant Creek, Bryah Basin and Mt Ida. Founded in 2005 as Fe Limited, it took its current name in November 2021 and has its office in West Leederville.
